hypothesis: Past-only range, upward and downward labels predict subsequent price behavior better than a simple baseline on the same ticker and sample

features.range_bounds: highest high and lowest low of the previous N closed bars; current bar excluded
features.range_width: (resistance - support) / ATR(14); a range label also requires current close inside the frozen boundaries
features.direction: (current close - close N bars ago) / ATR(14)
features.confirmation: classification made only after the current bar is closed

forecast_targets.range: all next H closes stay inside support and resistance frozen at prediction time
forecast_targets.trend_up: close H bars later exceeds close at prediction time
forecast_targets.trend_down: close H bars later is below close at prediction time
forecast_targets.uncertain: no directional forecast; count its frequency

evaluation: label frequency and forecast hit rate by ticker, timeframe, horizon and early/late sample
range baseline is the outcome frequency among all bars whose current close is inside the preceding range
up/down baseline is the unconditional outcome frequency among all valid bars
lift in percentage points against the relevant baseline
label stability across neighboring thresholds and time periods
anti_overfit_rules: no feature may use a candle after the classification time
forward outcomes are evaluation labels, never classifier inputs
holdout period and ticker set fixed before examining results
all parameter combinations and losses retained
overlapping forecast horizons are descriptive and not independent trials
no EMA, trading signal, position, or paper-account decision is included
